rows.en: ＊Sakaki＊＠００９＿００５This exam is "EVA," a spacewalk.￥You'll simulate repairing damage￥to a spaceship.

＊Sakaki＊＠００９＿００６Going outside with nothing but￥a suit is extremely dangerous.＝＠００９＿００７Never let your guard down during￥the exam.＝＠００９＿００８One wrong move could cost you￥your life, so please be very￥careful.
